episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Megatron urges Optimus Prime to accept a treaty, while Starscream questions Jetfire's leadership. The Autobots try to recruit Bumblebee to their side.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Megatron receives a surprise visitor; Shockwave reveals how finding the mythical Allspark can help defeat the Autobots. The Decepticons lay a trap.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Optimus has a plan but needs Ratchet's help. Ultra Magnus is tortured for information while Starscream continues to foster dissent among the Seekers.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Elita casts doubt on Optimus' plan, which includes fixing a Spacebridge. Optimus appeals to the Guardians for help and Bumblebee receives a high honor.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Jetfire offers to help Optimus retrieve the Allspark. Bumblebee, Cog and Arcee go on a mission for energon; Wheeljack tries to get the Ark to fly.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Optimus struggles to obtain the Allspark. Megatron figures out Optimus' plan and orders an attack on the Autobots, who receive an unexpected assist.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Believing the Allspark destroyed, Megatron plans to flee the dying planet — but at great cost. Elita's plan to free some prisoners hits a snag.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Mercenary Transformers come upon the Ark adrift in space. As unlikely allies arrive to rescue the imprisoned Autobots, Megatron reveals Project Nemesis.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: The Autobots locate the Allspark, but a deserted space station and its lone occupant stand in the way. The Decepticons catch up with the Ark.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Megatron faces a life-or-death situation. As the Autobots and Decepticons work together to fight against Scorponok, Starscream tries to seize power.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Optimus encounters an unexpected guide who shows him a possible future. Megatron meets an entity who tells him what he needs to take from Optimus.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Above the planet where the Allspark lies, the Autobots and Decepticons battle while Deseeus closes in to exact revenge upon them all.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: After crash-landing at different locations, the Autobots and the Decepticons encounter the planet's denizens and are shocked to learn who they are.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Megatron acquires an advantage in locating the Allspark. The Maximals mount a rescue attempt when the Predacons capture one of their teammates.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: As the Autobots and the Decepticons close in on it, the Allspark launches a defense system that alters perception and disrupts all functionality.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Megatron's continued use of the Golden Disk to guide his actions threatens to derail Optimus Prime's attempt to obtain the Allspark.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: The Autobots and the Maximals attempt to launch the Ark to return to Cybertron. They meet heavy resistance — until something extraordinary occurs.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: The past, present and future collide on Cybertron as the final showdown for the Allspark begins with some unexpected participants.
